prompt:
A black-and-white CHILDREN'S COLORING BOOK page, square 1:1, 1080x1080.

THIS IS A MACRO CLOSE-UP SHOT, LIKE A ZOOMED-IN PHONE CAMERA PHOTO TAKEN TOO CLOSE. The subject is so close to the "camera" that it does NOT fully fit in the frame: the top of the delivery-van character and the top of the big cell character are CUT OFF by the TOP edge, their rounded bodies are CUT OFF by the LEFT and RIGHT edges, and their bottoms/wheels are CUT OFF by the BOTTOM edge. There must be ZERO empty white background space visible anywhere in the image — every part of the 1080x1080 canvas is covered by either black line-art or white space that belongs INSIDE a drawn shape. If you can see plain empty background at any edge, the drawing is WRONG — redo it bigger and closer.

SCENE (draw it oversized, then let the frame crop it): A cheerful round cartoon "gene-delivery van" character — a friendly virus shaped like a chubby little delivery van with a smooth rounded dome roof, two small round wheels, big happy cartoon eyes and a big smile — has pulled up next to a giant friendly round CELL character (a big circle with a smiling little nucleus face inside it and a small open hatch/door drawn on its side). Sticking out of the delivery-van character's roof are only five or six SHORT, BLUNT, ROUNDED stud bumps sitting flush and close to the roof like little knuckles or gumdrops — NOT spikes, NOT rays, NOT thorns, NOT a starburst. The van character is handing a single small gift-wrapped package (a simple square box with a bow, representing one gene) through the cell's open hatch with one stubby round arm/bump. The cell's hatch is a simple curved flap, already open, welcoming the package in — no fight, no forcing, both characters smiling. Keep the background almost bare aside from two or three simple rounded confetti dots near the package — no other objects, no starburst, no sparkle rays.

STYLE — coloring book line art: BOLD, THICK, EVEN BLACK OUTLINES on pure WHITE. Every shape fully closed. NO shading, NO grey tones, NO hatching, NO gradients, NO colour fill, NO solid black fills anywhere (eyes may have a small solid pupil only). Simple, cheerful, chunky shapes with open white space INSIDE each shape for colouring.

STRICTLY FORBIDDEN:
- Any visible empty white background, wall, sky or margin space — the artwork must be so zoomed-in and oversized that it touches or crosses every one of the four edges, with elements literally cut off by the edges.
- ANY starburst, radiating burst, sparkle rays, sunbeam rays, radiating speed lines, or halo of rays anywhere.
- Van character's roof bumps drawn as pointed spikes, thorns or anything radiating outward — short blunt rounded studs only, close to the roof.
- ANY rectangle, box outline, picture frame, panel edge, border line or vignette around the whole picture.
- NO text, letters, numbers, words, captions, labels, signatures or watermarks.
- NO speech bubble or thought bubble (added separately afterwards).
- NO fighting, no bite marks, no blood, no medical tools, no sick or sad character, no needles.
- NO full human figure or human face anywhere.
- The delivery-van character never bites, chases or forces its way into the cell — the hatch is already open and welcoming.
